pattern.short_summary: A single user request is dispatched unchanged to several distinct models at once, and their outputs are returned together.
pattern.definition: A single user request is dispatched unchanged to several distinct models at once, and their outputs are returned together. The variation the user sees comes from the difference between generators rather than from sampling one generator repeatedly. The outputs are attributable to their sources and set against each other.
pattern.structural_signature: Fan-out control flow: one input, n parallel invocations differing only in which backend is called, n outputs collected and presented in a common frame with source attribution. The key structural fact is that the *generator* is the varied dimension while the input is held constant — the inverse of perturbation probing. Transplants to any plural-backend setting: several solvers, several translation engines, several search indices.

dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.
